context: Mrs Mori has locked herself out of her apartment. She walks down to the koban; Officer Takeda is on duty.
purpose: tiny incidental help — neighborhood elder + officer

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: お巡りさん、家、入られへんようなって。
lines.en: Officer — I can't get into my house.
lines.style: A real fluster, Kansai cadence. Bag clutched.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 大丈夫ですよ。お家、どちらですか。
lines.style: A small calming line. Pen in hand.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: すぐそこ。本当に、すみません。
lines.en: Just over there. Truly, I'm sorry.
lines.style: A small apologetic fluster — genuine and unforced throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 一緒に行きましょう。鍵の業者、呼べますから。
lines.en: Let's go together. We can call a locksmith.
lines.style: A small practical kindness — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: お時間、本当にありがとう。
lines.en: Truly — thank you for the time.
lines.style: A small Kansai-style relief — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 気にしないでください。お先に。
lines.style: A small polite gesture. Opens the door in the voice.
